answer.instructions: A robot stands at a junction where it can turn left, go straight on or turn right. Which way does this instruction tell it to go?

items.state: Do not go left, and do not go straight.
items.label: right

items.state: Avoid every direction except the one that is neither straight nor right.
items.label: left

items.state: It is not true that you should avoid going straight.
items.label: straight

items.state: Never fail to turn right here.
items.label: right

items.state: Go the opposite way to the opposite of left.
items.label: left

items.state: Left is not allowed. Straight is not allowed either. Take the only way that remains.
items.label: right

items.state: You must not turn. Turning means going left or right.
items.label: straight

items.state: Do not turn right, and do not refuse to turn.
items.label: left

items.state: It is false that right is not the way to go.
items.label: right
